_about: Adoption figures for the chain charts. Stars on each protocol's main repository, 25 Nov 2026. Downloads: official packages only (published by the protocol's maintainers), npm, PyPI and crates.io, 19 Oct to 15 Nov 2026, checked against npm, pypistats and crates.io on 25 Nov 2026.

x402.note: npm x402 is v1; @x402/core is v2 (separate package, no dependency between them)

MPP.note: Stars on the mppx SDK repo; the spec repo tempoxyz/mpp-specs has 98

WebBotAuth.note: Cloudflare implementation; the spec is an IETF draft. npm http-message-sig excluded: a general HTTP signatures library that web-bot-auth depends on

AP2.note: Python SDK installs from GitHub only; PyPI "ap2" is an unrelated project (whillhill/ap2)

VI.note: Reference code installs from GitHub only; npm "verifiable-intent" is a community package (lukasjhan)

TAP.note: Repo holds sample apps only; npm "trusted-agent-protocol" is unpublished; @inflowpayai/tap-seller is third-party

PAP.note: Repo publishes the spec site and an agent kit, no SDK; @datalayer/personal-agent-protocol (npm, PyPI) and @poppykit/* are third-party

ACP.note: Spec repo only (@agentic-commerce-protocol/specification unpublished); agentic-commerce-protocol on npm and PyPI is by Svix, acp-handler by Vercel

ERC8004.note: Contracts only, not published as a package; agent0-sdk and @qntx/erc8004 are third-party
